scope: frozen CMS Run2016G low-mass data fits plus held-out Z template closure; regression evidence, not a CMS detector calibration

z.basis: CMS Z to mumu residual uncertainty

jpsi.basis: CMS J/psi standard-candle peak; broad peak-fit regression band

upsilon_1s.basis: PDG peak mass and broad band spanning CMS 69 MeV central and 96 MeV inclusive resolution results

upsilon_2s.basis: PDG peak mass; detector mass-scale regression band

upsilon_3s.basis: PDG peak mass; detector mass-scale regression band

resolution_band_method: Broad envelopes digitized from CMS-PAS-MUO-21-001 Figure 17-a pp data. They are regression guardrails, not tabulated official CMS measurements.
limits: The low-mass sample is only the first 100000 entries of one Run2016G file, not a luminosity-representative dataset.
CMS comparison plots use different selections and collision conditions; the eta envelopes are broad cross-era regression bounds.
The Z check is a held-out data/MC template closure, not a precision Z mass measurement.
Passing these checks is regression evidence, not a physics-validation claim for the detector simulator.
